_Most machine learning never makes it to production. Your job is to make sure ours does. We are looking for an ML Engineer who turns models into reliable, maintained systems that construction companies actually use to make better decisions about their equipment and operations. You will work at the intersection of data science and software engineering, shaping how machine learning gets built, deployed, and improved at Trackunit.

**What’s in it for you?

Bring machine learning into everyday use. Turn models and experiments into reliable products that help customers make better decisions about their equipment and operations.

Shape how we build and run ML. Influence the tools, engineering practices, and deployment patterns that take solutions from an initial idea through to production and continuous improvement.

Work on interesting data challenges. Explore how equipment, sensor, and contextual data can support useful predictions and insights for the construction industry.

Build alongside people with different strengths. Collaborate with data scientists, data engineers, and product teams, combining scientific thinking with practical software engineering and customer understanding.

Develop your craft and your career. Join an international environment with knowledge sharing, feedback, and support for your personal and professional development.

**Who are you ideally?

**

• You have MLOps experience taking machine learning solutions into production and maintaining them beyond their initial release.

• You bring strong Python skills and solid software engineering practices, including testing, version control, code reviews, and CI/CD.

• Databricks expertise is a significant advantage.

• You ideally bring strong hands-on experience building ML workflows in Databricks, tracking experiments and managing models with MLflow, and deploying and monitoring models in production.

• You understand the ML lifecycle, from feature preparation and reproducible training to evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

• You can work with data scientists to assess model performance, recognise issues such as data leakage and drift, and translate experimental code into maintainable systems.

• You have experience with cloud platforms and tools for orchestrating ML workflows and serving predictions. You can make sensible trade-offs between reliability, performance, and cost.

• You enjoy shaping solutions with others, explaining technical choices clearly, and connecting engineering decisions to customer needs.

• Experience training, tuning, and validating machine learning or deep learning models would be a plus.

• Experience with time series, sensor or geospatial data, or distributed processing would be a plus.

You don’t need experience with every tool or data type listed. If you bring strong engineering skills and enjoy making machine learning useful in practice, we’d like to hear from you.

**Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

The Role

Our purpose

Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, with offices in the UK, Norway and Germany, and supports over 400,000 users across Europe and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

How you'll make an impact

The Monetization team owns how customers buy and keep buying Planday: the checkout experience, subscription management, payments, and the systems behind them (our subscription and billing services, plus the integration layer to Zuora, Salesforce and Intercom). When a customer upgrades a plan, adds a product, or gets an invoice, that is our code path.

As a Full Stack Engineer at IC2, you will build and maintain features across that path, front end and back end, with support from engineers on the team. You will start with well-scoped pieces of customer-facing work and grow into owning features end to end.

You will join a cross-functional team of full stack engineers, a QA engineer, a UX researcher and a product manager. You will be paired with an engineer as your mentor from day one, and you will be expected to ask questions early and often: in a domain where mistakes are visible on customer invoices.

You will use AI coding tools every day, as the whole team does. We care less about how fast you can produce code and more about whether you can tell good output from plausible-looking output, and whether you can explain and defend what you ship.

What you'll do

• 
Create software: Build features across the stack: C# / .NET services and React + TypeScript front ends (We have one service in Java). Contribute to solution design discussions and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.

• 
Work with AI tools, with judgement: Use AI coding assistants as part of normal delivery. Read, test and question what they produce. Never merge code you cannot explain line by line.

• 
Test software: Write and automate tests alongside your changes. Treat quality as part of the work rather than a later stage, with support from the team's QA engineer.

• 
Resolve issues: Help triage and fix development and production issues in the subscription, checkout and payments flows. Learn to trace a problem across services and third-party platforms, and communicate impact in business terms.

• 
Engineering standards : Learn and apply Planday's Engineering Standards. Take part in the Backend and Frontend Guilds to build a shared standard with engineers outside the team.

• 
Understand the domain : Build working knowledge of how plans, entitlements, invoices and payments fit together. In monetization, the business rules are the hard part; the code is often the easy part.

• 
Continuous improvement : Keep growing your knowledge of the technologies we use, and bring back what you learn to the team.

• 
Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

Success looks like

• 
First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• 
First twelve months: you own well-scoped features end to end across front end and back end, you catch your own errors before review does, you are a dependable second pair of eyes in code review, and you can explain the customer and revenue impact of what you build.

• 
Quality and pace: You deliver at a predictable, sustainable pace and flag risks and blockers early rather than at the deadline.

• 
Learning: You actively learn from your peers, act on feedback, and turn each review comment into something you no longer need told twice.

• 
Judgment with AI: You use AI tools to move faster without lowering the bar: you verify output, you confidently spot wrong suggestions, and you own everything you merge.

• 
Communication: You keep your team informed, write clearly in tickets and pull requests, and give Product accurate information so scope and timing decisions can be made.

What you'll bring with you

Critical competencies

• 
Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• 
Verification habit: You check things: you read the error, you run the test, you look at the data before you conclude.

• 
Problem-solving: You can break a problem down and describe your reasoning out loud, including the parts you are unsure about.

• 
Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

• 
Communication and time management: You are clear about progress, blockers and what you need.

• 
Care for the customer: You understand that billing and checkout bugs cost customers money and trust.

Experience we would like to see

We expect a junior engineer here to have roughly 1 to 2 years of professional experience, or equivalent evidence of building and shipping real software (internships, open-source, freelance).

• 
Working knowledge of one backend language, ideally C# / .NET

• 
Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript, and a component framework such as React

• 
Comfortable with SQL and relational data

• 
Comfortable with Git, pull requests and code review

• 
Familiar with consuming and building REST APIs

• 
Some exposure to automated testing

• 
Hands-on use of AI coding tools (for example Claude, Codex, Copilot or Cursor) and an opinion about where they help and where they do not

• 
Nice to have: exposure to CI/CD, cloud platforms (we run on Azure), Redis, message-based integration between systems, or billing and subscription domains

You do not need to tick every line. If you can show us that you build things, verify your own work, and learn fast, we want to talk to you.

How we use AI in this hiring process

We use AI tools in our daily work, so we do not pretend otherwise when hiring.

• 
The technical interview: it runs in two halves. First you read and review code with your AI tools closed, so we can see how you read. Then you open your usual tools and build, as you would on the job. We will tell you exactly when the switch happens.

• 
What we assess: your reasoning, your ability to explain and defend code (including code that a tool wrote), and your judgement about when to trust output. Using AI is not a problem; being unable to explain your work is.

At Planday, we offer you

• 
Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• 
On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• 
Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• 
Flexible remote work

• 
Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• 
Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• 
Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

Are you commercially driven and motivated by turning customer insights into products and services that create real value? We are looking for a Product Manager, Ancillaries to develop and grow our product and services portfolio across the customer journey, balancing customer experience with sustainable and profitable revenue growth.

**About The Position

**As Product Manager, Ancillaries, you will be part of the Product, Ancillaries & Inflight Services team within our Commercial Department. The position is based in Copenhagen with the possibility of hybrid working.

You will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and growing our ancillary product and services portfolio. This includes both identifying new commercial opportunities and continuously developing our existing products and services to ensure they remain relevant, attractive, and commercially successful.

You will play a key role in strengthening our customer value proposition and driving profitable growth.

The portfolio includes products and services such as seats, baggage, lounges, fast track, and our Inflight Shop. You will work closely with colleagues across Customer Experience, Crew, Tour Operations, and other commercial functions, as well as with external partners.

**Your Main Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Develop and optimize our ancillary products and services, including seats, baggage, lounges, fast track, and the Inflight Shop.

• Continuously improve existing solutions to ensure they remain relevant, attractive, and commercially successful.

• Identify new product, service, and revenue opportunities based on customer insights, performance data, market developments, and industry trends.

• Lead new concepts from idea to launch, working across relevant functions and stakeholder groups.

• Use BI reporting and performance metrics to evaluate profitability, identify opportunities, and support commercial decisions.

• Drive the development of our ancillary offering across relevant sales channels in close collaboration with Tour Operations and other key stakeholders.

• Manage and develop relationships with external providers and commercial partners.

**Who We Are Looking For

**You have a strong commercial mindset and experience working with products, revenue, or commercial development. You understand how to connect customer needs, data, and business opportunities, and you are motivated by turning insights into products and initiatives that create measurable value.

**Must Haves

**

• Relevant commercial experience within product management, product ownership, commercial strategy, product revenue, revenue optimization, or a comparable area.

• A relevant degree or equivalent practical commercial experience.

• A strong understanding of profitability, growth, pricing, and commercial value creation.

• Experience using data, performance metrics, or BI reporting to identify opportunities and support decision-making.

• The ability to interpret reports and challenge how data is structured, presented, and used, rather than simply accepting existing reporting at face value.

• Experience driving initiatives across different functions and stakeholder groups.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

• The ability to take ownership and move initiatives forward in a dynamic environment.

• Fluent written and spoken English.

• The ability to understand and communicate in at least one Scandinavian language: Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian.

We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, and commercially minded. You naturally look for opportunities to improve products and create profitable growth, while keeping the customer experience in focus.

You work analytically and use data to guide decisions, but you are equally comfortable collaborating with different stakeholders and turning analysis into action. You are structured, results-oriented, and willing to challenge existing ways of working when you see an opportunity to create a better outcome. Personal qualities are important to us.

**We offer

**We offer an exciting and developing environment where you get the opportunity for an internal career. We have a high level of employee engagement, which is shown year after year in our internal employee survey. We love our job and welcome you on board our journey in the Nordic Leisure Travel Group!

**Other Information

**Deadline for applying: 1st. of November

Start: After agreement, preferably January 2027

Contact: If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Tobias Ögren, Head of Product, Ancillaries & Inflight Services: tobias.ogren@sunclass.dk

You will be employed by a Danish airline which means you have to go through a security background check by the Danish police.

We’re looking forward to your application!

Sunclass Airlines is part of the Nordic Leisure Travel Group (NLTG), which consists of the tour operators Spies in Denmark, Ving and Globetrotter in Sweden, Ving in Norway, Tjäreborg in Finland and the hotel company Resorts & Hotels. Sunclass Airlines flies the majority of the travel group's guests to our charter destinations and has over 1.000.000 travelers per year.

Read more about us at sunclassairlines.dk.

**Client Management

**As part of the production of our digital marketing products, we are looking for a Client Manager to join our growing team. In this role, you support our clients throughout their website journey, from the first conversation to publication, and help them get the most out of their new digital presence quickly and smoothly.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• You will contact our Dutch- and English-speaking customers across the world (no sales) via welcome calls for our website and digital marketing products.

• You will discuss the clients' requirements for their website, consult on structure, and ensure all expectations are clearly defined, keeping the bigger picture of their business goals in mind.

• After the website has been created by our web designers, you will coordinate final revision requests and ensure successful publication.

• You will handle domain and email account transfers on behalf of clients.

• You increasingly work alongside AI-supported tools that simplify parts of the process, giving you more time to focus on the client rather than paperwork.

• With your positive, consultative and service-oriented approach, you contribute daily to delivering an outstanding client experience.

**Your profile

**

• You have professional experience in client service and enjoy daily client interaction.

• Your affinity for digital products and processes allows you to quickly familiarise yourself with new systems, including AI-supported tools and workflows.

• You have a basic understanding of website structure and design principles, and you can explain steps and results to clients in an understandable way.

• Experience with CRM systems is a plus.

• You have excellent written and spoken Dutch and English language skills.

**Why this role is different

**You are not just processing requests. You guide clients through one of the most visible moments in their business, the launch of their new website, and you see the direct result of your work go live. You work closely with an international team, and increasingly alongside AI supported tools that take over routine steps in the process. That gives you more room to focus on what actually matters, the client in front of you.

**About Us

**group.one is a leading European provider of online presence, cloud hosting, and digital marketing services. Over 2 million customers trust us with their online success. Our global team consists of 1 500+ employees operating from nearly 20 locations across 15 countries, with our headquarters in Sweden. Thanks to the support of our partners Cinven and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan, we are steadily expanding the group's service portfolio and geographical footprint.

When you join group.one, you become a part of a global network that values collaboration, growth, and excellence. Join us in creating online success stories!

**We are committed to an inclusive and safe environment, free from discrimination and harassment.

****We welcome talent in all its diversity. Your gender, background, age, beliefs, or personal story do not define your opportunities here - what matters to us is mutual respect, personal appreciation, and creating a workplace where motivation and collaboration thrive. We believe in supporting your personal and professional growth, recognising you as both an individual and a valued team member.

****We want to continue to grow with you and why we look forward to getting to know you.

**Welcome to one.com, where innovation meets passion. We are a leading web hosting and domain registration company dedicated to empowering individuals and businesses online. Since 2002, we have been committed to delivering reliable, user-friendly, and affordable web services. Our mission is to make it easy for anyone to build and maintain an online presence, and we believe in integrity, innovation, and putting our customers first.

Are you passionate about turning business challenges into impactful AI solutions? As our AI Business Partner, you will lead AI adoption within the business, identify opportunities, drive innovation, and translate business needs into tangible value through AI

**About The Job

**As an AI Business Partner, you will act as the bridge between business strategy and AI execution. You will uncover high-value AI opportunities, develop and prioritize AI roadmaps, and lead initiatives from concept to scalable adoption. By embedding AI into core business processes, you will help deliver measurable improvements in performance and efficiency.

The role spans business partnering, change leadership, governance, and value realization, making it ideal for someone who excels driving cross-functional collaboration and translating ambition into business impact.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Own and structure AI roadmaps, opportunity pipelines and business cases

• Play an active part in driving initiatives end-to-end from ideation and scoping through implementation, adoption and workflow embedding

• Ensure local adherence to AI governance, compliance requirements and approved ways of working, including risk reviews, exceptions and local signoffs

• Act as the primary link between business areas and the AI Office, escalating risks, decisions and prioritization needs when required

• Facilitate workshops, training, community sessions and demonstrations that accelerate adoption and continuous learning

• Track and communicate adoption, benefits and business impact, and help scale successful solutions across relevant teams

**Who are you?

**You combine strong business understanding with genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology. You create structure in ambiguity, build trusted relationships, and take ownership for moving initiatives forward. We are not looking for a hands-on developer – instead, we are looking for someone who has a strong business acumen and is comfortable discussing AI-enabled workflows, low-code/no-code AI and automation possibilities, governance and value creation with both business and specialist stakeholders.

We expect that you:

• Have a relevant higher education in business, digital transformation, technology, innovation, or a related field

• Bring at least three years of relevant experience from business partnering, digital transformation, AI, portfolio management, consulting or cross-functional program delivery

• Have experience translating business priorities into concrete initiatives, business cases and implementation plans

• Possess strong stakeholder management, project management skills and communication skills across operational teams and senior stakeholders

• Understand AI opportunities and limitations and have sound judgement in a regulated, compliance-aware environment

• Are structured, proactive, collaborative and focused on outcomes and measurable impact

• Communicate proficiently in English

**Who are we?

**You will report to the Head of AI and be anchored in Orifarm’s AI Office while working closely with the business, acting as the key link between local priorities and Orifarm-wide AI standards. We collaborate closely with stakeholders across functions and countries to turn ideas into real solutions.

We foster a hands-on, curious, and experimental culture, where learning and iteration are part of everyday work. You will be joining a team where you are trusted to take ownership, contribute with ideas, and help shape how AI is used across Orifarm.

**Why should you join Orifarm?

**At Orifarm, we are united by a shared purpose: improving access to affordable medicine for the people who need it. Founded in Odense, Denmark in 1994 by Birgitte & Hans Bøgh-Sørensen, we have built our business on challenging conventional thinking to make affordable high-quality pharmaceuticals more accessible across Europe. Rather than developing new medicines, we focus on finding smarter ways to bring existing treatments to patients, creating value for pharmacies, healthcare systems, and society.

We live by the mindset Challenge Accepted . It reflects our explorer spirit and can-do attitude, where challenges are perceived as opportunities. We encourage people to ask questions, challenge assumptions, and take ownership. Across teams, functions, and markets, you will find a collaborative and supportive culture built on trust, respect, and a flat hierarchy where everyone has a voice and direct access to decision-makers.

When you join Orifarm, you will be empowered to make a real impact from day one. We offer autonomy and great opportunities for career advancement, enabling our employees to shape their professional development. We value flexibility and provide a hybrid work model with the possibility of working from home two days a week.

We invite you to join Orifarm, if you are curious, ambitious, and accept the challenge of bringing better deals of medicine to millions.

**We encourage everyone to apply

**At Orifarm, we welcome people from all backgrounds, recognizing that the best outcomes come from a diverse and inclusive work environment. Our commitment is to create an environment where different perspectives and skills drive innovation and contribute to a sustainable future. By creating such an environment, we are confident that we can achieve better results together.

As a Domain Delivery Specialist, your primary responsibility will be to oversee and manage all domain-related orders from clients, whether received directly or through the sales team. You will plan and execute these orders within the defined project scope, ensuring they are completed efficiently in alignment with project goals. This role requires strong organizational skills, as you will have full responsibility for managing and delivering orders on time and according to client expectations.

Our Domain Delivery Specialist reports directly to the Domain Delivery Manager.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Manage Domain Orders: Execute assigned domain-related orders efficiently and in line with company and client expectations.

• 
Plan and Prioritize: Organize and prioritize domain-related orders/projects, always considering the best interests of both the client and the internal team.

• 
Maintain Accuracy and Standards: Ensure all tasks are performed with precision and in accordance with industry best practices.

• 
Client Communication and Expertise: Act as the domain expert, providing guidance to clients and keeping them informed throughout the order/project lifecycle.

• 
Collaborate on Projects: Provide support to colleagues on their orders as needed.

• 
Identify Business Opportunities: Proactively seek and generate new business opportunities within the scope of assigned orders.

• 
Drive Continuous Improvement: Work closely with other departments to identify areas for improvement, refining processes, routines, and internal guides for domain management.

Qualifications and Skills:

• 
Industry Expertise: In-depth knowledge of the domain industry and familiarity with relevant products and services.

• 
Adaptable & Quick Thinking: Able to respond swiftly to new challenges and changes, making effective decisions in fast-paced environments.

• 
Problem-Solving & Conflict Resolution: Skilled in identifying solutions and effectively resolving conflicts.

• 
Strong Interpersonal Skills: Excellent communication abilities, both written and verbal, with the ability to build positive relationships.

• 
Organizational Skills: Ability to prioritize and structure daily and weekly tasks efficiently to maximize productivity.

• 
Proficient in English: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

• 
Team Player & Independent Worker: Capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team environment.

• 
Technologically Savvy: Comfortable with technology and quick to adopt new tools and systems.

• 
Quick Learner: Ability to absorb new information quickly and apply it effectively.

Domain Delivery Specialist plays a critical role in ensuring Abions Domain services and the long-term success of the business. This position requires a strong focus on accuracy, service and developing knowledge within the industry.

KPIs

• 
Number of successfully processed and registered domains.

• 
Timeliness and accuracy in completing assigned tasks.

Why choose Abion?

Join Europe’s leading Intellectual Property firm, where you'll thrive in a fast-paced, international environment that values transparency, openness, and accountability.

At Abion, we believe in working hard and having fun together. In this dynamic role, you’ll make an impact in the IP world while collaborating with a talented, global team of experts. We encourage a balanced lifestyle, offering freedom with responsibility. Plus, we love celebrating successes and enjoying team activities that bring us closer together!

Ready to Join Us?

If you are ready to make a significant impact in the Intellectual Property industry, we would love to hear from you. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible, no later than October 25.

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences.

**About Sedna

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About The Role

**As an Account Director at Sedna, you'll carry a blended number: winning new logos across the commodities and owner/operator/charterer segments, and expanding our relationships with the key customers already in your portfolio.

This is a senior, strategic sales position. On the new business side, you'll run the full cycle - from prospecting through to close - bringing new shipping and trading companies onto Sedna's platform. On the account side, you'll act as a trusted advisor to our most important existing customers, deepening engagement and identifying new opportunities for expansion. Either way, you're driving revenue growth with the autonomy and accountability of a founder, and helping customers unlock the full potential of Sedna's AI-powered platform.

Working in a fast-growth company means that no day is ever the same! But here are the main responsibilities and tasks you'll undertake while working for us:

Industry and product knowledge

• Developing deep knowledge of the commodities, owner, operator and charterer segments within maritime to build credibility and tailor your approach to each prospect's and customer's unique needs.

• Increasing your expertise in Sedna's product, understanding its core features, capabilities and how it addresses challenges faced by our largest customers.

• Leveraging case studies and success stories from current clients to provide insights and strategies that improve outcomes for prospects and customers alike.

• Using Sedna's platform extensively to ensure familiarity with its features, value propositions and potential use cases for different parts of a business.

New business development

• Building and qualifying a pipeline of high-potential new-logo prospects across the commodities and owner/operator/charterer segments.

• Researching and prioritising target accounts based on size, tech stack and operational complexity.

• Running discovery conversations and tailored demos that connect a prospect's operational challenges to Sedna's platform capabilities.

• Leading the full sales cycle for new business - scoping, negotiation and close - with commercial rigour and customer-centricity.

• Representing Sedna at relevant international maritime events to build visibility and network with potential buyers.

• Ensuring a smooth handover to onboarding and success teams so new customers experience immediate value.

Account strategy and growth

• Building and executing account strategies for key customers to ensure sustained value and expansion of Sedna's footprint.

• Engaging with senior stakeholders across departments within your accounts to identify new opportunities for growth, leveraging existing relationships to introduce additional Sedna solutions.

• Developing a deep understanding of your customers' strategic goals and aligning Sedna's offerings to help them achieve long-term success.

• Ensuring a thorough understanding of each customer's internal workflows and how Sedna can be further integrated to optimise efficiency.

Driving growth and expansion

• Identifying upsell opportunities within your existing accounts by understanding customers' evolving needs and challenges.

• Working alongside the solutions consultancy team to lead product demonstrations and scoping sessions to highlight the benefits of expanding Sedna's use across different teams and departments.

• Collaborating with the Customer Success, Product and Implementation teams to facilitate smooth rollouts and ensure successful adoption of expanded services.

• Managing contract renewals and expansions, ensuring that all commercial terms are aligned with your growth targets and the customer's needs.

• Working with RevOps and Finance to ensure company best practices are followed across new business, renewals and expansions.

Stakeholder engagement

• Mapping out key decision-makers within prospects and existing accounts and establishing strong, trusted relationships with them.

• Acting as the main point of contact for senior stakeholders and ensuring Sedna is viewed as a strategic partner, not just a vendor.

• Hosting regular business reviews and strategic planning sessions with key accounts to track progress, uncover opportunities and ensure ongoing success.

Continuous improvement

• Contributing and maintaining data for effective forecasting across both new business and existing accounts.

• Contributing to the Product, Marketing, Success and other teams to help Sedna be a better company and platform, and in turn, make a bigger impact on our customers.

• Reflecting on successes and failures, and making improvements to your ways of working as a result.

**About You

**Proven, direct management of client relations at C-suite level is essential - this is a senior role and requires building and maintaining strong, strategic relationships with both prospects and existing customers from day one.

At Sedna, we believe it's your skills and attributes that ultimately make you successful in a role. Here's what we're looking for:

• Experience - a minimum of 10 years' experience in client-facing, sales or account management roles, with a proven track record of both winning new logos and growing large strategic accounts. Shipping or maritime industry experience is highly valued - we're looking for someone who already understands our customers' world.

• Self motivated - you are motivated to achieve in this role because of your enthusiasm - you relish pressure from others but don't need it to succeed.

• Concise communicator - you can articulate a message in a calm, clear, focused way. You hold your audience's attention, and they retain what you tell them. Equally, you actively listen and interpret what your audience tells you.

• Emotionally intelligent - you understand, use and control your emotions in positive ways, to relieve stress, empathise with others, overcome challenges, and diffuse conflict.

• Technical aptitude - you keep abreast with modern technologies and have the ability to learn and master them quickly.

• Coachability - you have the ability to adapt and improve as required.

**Our Values

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of the OS together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

jobs.occupation: HSO International - Microsoft D365 Project Manager
jobs.description:
HSO International – Project Manager

Position: Project Manager

Department: Program Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in your country of residence within the EMEA region. Sponsorship and relocation only available within the Netherlands

Type of work: Remote or Hybrid, depending on location

International travel is required depending on program needs. **Minimun 35% travelling

****About The Role

**The Project Manager at HSO is accountable for the successful delivery of a defined project or major workstream within a broader transformation program. This role owns delivery outcomes within clear boundaries: scope, schedule, quality, readiness, and customer adoption for their project.

In this role, your primary focus is on driving execution excellence. You spend most of your time on detailed planning, sequencing, dependency management, readiness control (testing, data, cutover), issue resolution, and day-to-day delivery leadership. You optimize outcomes within given constraints and ensure that delivery reality is visible early.

If you want a role where you own the execution layer of large or complex global programs and make a direct impact on delivery success, this is it.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own day-to-day delivery of assigned projects or complex program workstreams, ensuring scope, plan, dependencies, and customer readiness remain aligned

• Participate in pre-sales and mobilization by shaping delivery plans, budgets, governance models, and risk assumptions that are executable in practice

• Contribute to and co-author Statements of Work (SOW), with specific accountability for assumptions, risks, delivery economics, team structures, phase entry/exit criteria, and change control

• Build and maintain integrated delivery plans that align architecture, build, testing, integrations, and customer activities

• Coordinate cross-functional delivery across architects, developers, functional consultants, testers, integration teams, and customer SMEs

• Monitor requirements gathering and setting acceptance criteria, ensure backlog items are sized, prioritized, and ready for build

• Drive testing readiness, including test planning, data availability, environment coordination, defect management, and go-live preparation

• Maintain strong RAID discipline, proactively identifying risks, issues, dependencies, and downstream impacts

• Identify scope gaps early and initiate structured change-control discussions when required

• Run governance forums that drive real decisions, including steering committees, risk reviews, and change control boards

• Communicate clear, factual status and risk updates to customers, senior project managers, and program leadership

• Partner with customers to strengthen their ability to participate effectively in requirements, testing, data readiness, and decision-making

• Contribute to continuous improvement of HSO’s Standard Working Practices (SWP) and delivery quality culture

• Depending on seniority and complexity of an assigned project, you will work under the guidance and direction of a Senior Project Manager or Program Manager.

**Requirements

**

• 3–5+ year’s experience delivering ERP. Data, or digital transformation projects experience is preferable into ERP Implementation experience

• Must exposure to Dynamics 365 ERP experience or comparable enterprise platforms

• Experience in complex, multi-team or multi-stakeholder environments

• Strong grounding in planning, backlog management, requirements clarification, testing preparation, and RAID (Risks, Actions, Issues, and Decisions)

• Experience working within structured delivery frameworks and governance models

• Ability to see and manage task-level delays and manage their downstream impacts

• Ability to simplify complexity and drive clarity in pressured environments

• Experience using DevOps or similar delivery management tools.

• Hands-on, structured, and proactive approach to execution and problem solving.

• Confidence to escalate issues factually and early

• Influence without authority; create clarity and accountability through facts, options, and trade-offs

• Structured approach to risk management, ambiguity, and scenario-based decision-making

• Awareness of delivery economics and commercial impact

• Ability to balance scope, quality, time, and cost without false certainty

• International travel required depending on program needs. Minimun 35% travelling

**Benefits

****Why should you choose HSO International?

****_Development and growth

_**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and a distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents, and ambitions.

**Career Path for this role

****HSO Offers a Clear, Capability-based Progression For Delivery Professionals

**Project Coordinator / PMO → Project Manager → Senior Project Manager → Program Manager.

Project Managers grow by mastering execution discipline, customer leadership, and cross-team coordination within global transformation programs.

**_Fun and success

_**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**_International project exposure

_**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**_Freedom and responsibility

_**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

jobs.occupation: Chauffør til fælgværksted i Søborg – Hjulfix / Driver for rim workshop in Søborg – Hjulfix
jobs.description:
Vil du have et job, hvor du er på farten hver dag og møder kunderne ansigt til ansigt? Hos Hjulfix i Søborg søger vi en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der står for afhentning og levering af hjul og fælge hos vores kunder. Det er primært værksteder, bilforhandlere og skadecentre i Storkøbenhavn og på Sjælland.

Hos Hjulfix kommer du til at arbejde tæt sammen med vores værksted for reparation af fælge i Søborg, hvor vi renoverer, retter og lakerer omkring 10.000 fælge om året. Du bliver bindeleddet mellem kunderne og værkstedet, så din indsats har stor betydning for, at fælgene kommer sikkert frem og tilbage til tiden.

Dine opgaver

• 
Afhente og levere hjul og fælge hos værksteder og skadecentre i Storkøbenhavn og på Sjælland

• 
Planlægge din rute sammen med værkstedet, så kunderne får deres fælge til aftalt tid

• 
Håndtere og sikre hjul og fælge forsvarligt under transport

• 
Have dialog med kunderne og sikre god service ved hver levering

• 
Hjælpe til i værkstedet, når du er tilbage fra køreturen, fx med af- og påmontering og klargøring

Vi forventer, at du

• 
Har kørekort kategori B (almindelig bil)

• 
Er vant til at køre varebil og kender trafikken i Storkøbenhavn

• 
Er mødestabil, pligtopfyldende og kan arbejde selvstændigt

• 
Taler dansk eller engelsk (gerne begge dele)

• 
Er serviceminded og giver gerne en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det

Vi tilbyder

• 
Fast fuldtidsstilling, mandag–fredag

• 
Mulighed for oplæring i forskellige opgaver i værkstedet, og din løn følger med, efterhånden som du lærer nye færdigheder

• 
En helt ny varebil, som bliver din til kørslen

• 
Varierede dage, hvor du starter med morgenens køretur, og når du er tilbage, hjælper du til med opgaver i værkstedet

En virksomhed i vækst med et godt og uformelt arbejdsmiljø

Om Hjulfix
Hjulfix er specialister i renovering af alufælge, fælgopretning, lakering og diamond cut. Vi servicerer værksteder, forhandlere og private kunder i hele Danmark fra vores værksted på Gladsaxe Møllevej 21 i Søborg.

Ansøgning
Send en kort ansøgning og dit CV til job@hjulfix.dk. Vi holder samtaler løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Har du spørgsmål, kan du ringe til Adrian på 42 46 27 75.

English version: Driver for rim workshop in Søborg – Hjulfix

Hjulfix in Søborg is looking for a reliable, service-minded driver to pick up and deliver wheels and rims for our customers. They are mainly garages, car dealers and body shops in Greater Copenhagen and on Zealand. Our workshop repairs, straightens and refinishes around 10,000 rims a year, and you'll be the link between our customers and the workshop.

Your tasks

• 
Pick up and deliver wheels and rims across Greater Copenhagen and Zealand

• 
Plan your route with the workshop so customers get their rims on time

• 
Handle and secure wheels and rims safely during transport

• 
Talk with customers and make sure every delivery goes smoothly

• 
Help out in the workshop when you're back from your run

We expect you to

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Be used to driving a van and know Copenhagen traffic

• 
Be reliable, punctual and able to work independently

• 
Speak English or Danish (both is a plus)

• 
Be service-minded and happy to lend a hand

We offer

• 
A permanent full-time job, Monday–Friday

• 
Training in different tasks in the workshop, with your salary growing as you learn new skills

• 
A brand-new van for your driving

• 
Varied days: you start with the morning run, and once you're back you help out with tasks in the workshop

• 
A growing company with a good, informal atmosphere

How to apply
Send a short application and your CV to job@hjulfix.dk. We interview on a rolling basis. For questions, call Adrian on +45 42 46 27 75.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception
jobs.description:
The Department of Psychology, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a fully funded postdoctoral position in computational modeling of visual perception. The position is available for up to 36 months and is part of a project led by Dr. Gregory Scott Francis that is supported by the SDU Department of Psychology. The starting date is March 15, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter.

Research environment

The postdoc will be affiliated with the Research Unit of Health and Cognitive Psychology. The position is at the SDU Esbjerg campus but will also involve interaction with staff at the SDU Odense campus. 

Project description

A basic process of the visual system is to monitor the location and characteristics of objects in a scene, and the multiple object tracking (MOT) paradigm has identified many fundamental aspects of this process. With a rich literature of empirical results, this paradigm is ready for theoretical development, which this project intends to pursue using an integrate-and-fire neural network model known as LAMINART. A key aspect of the model is the ability to select/segment visual objects, which may explain how people can (seemingly) effortlessly track multiple objects in a dynamic visual scene. 

The successful candidate will be required to design, program and analyze an integrate-and-fire neural network model of visual perception. Good programming (Python) skills are required along with a good understanding of empirical methods and ways to connect empirical findings with model behavior. The position also involves teaching duties.

The project involves collaboration with Prof. Søren Krogh Andersen, also at SDU.

Qualifications

Ideally, applicants for the position should satisfy the following requirements:

• 
PhD level in psychology, cognitive (neuro)science, vision science, or a related field

• 
Research experience as evidenced by conference contributions and peer-reviewed journal articles in a field related to the offered position

• 
Expertise in visual attention and perception

• 
Strong analytical skills, including the ability to design, implement, and analyze complex experiments

• 
Be willing and able to teach for the Department of Psychology

• 
Prior experience with neural network modeling is a plus

• 
Prior experience with cognitive modelling is a plus

• 
Good command of statistics

• 
Good command of Python (or similar programming languages and a willingness to learn)

• 
Very good command of the English language in spoken and written form

• 
Some knowledge of the Danish language is a plus

Candidates who are about to obtain these qualifications are also encouraged to apply. 

Contact information

For further information about the position, please contact Dr. Greg Francis, SDU (email: gfrancis@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 16 98), or Professor Søren Krogh Andersen (email: skandersen@health.sdu.dk; phone: +45 65 50 49 57)

Application deadline

The application deadline is November 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. CET.

Salary and terms of employment

The base salary for a postdoctoral researcher is DKK 36,877.42, with an additional job structure supplement of DKK 5,230.75. This brings the total monthly salary to DKK 42,108.16.

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be in English and submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". 

Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
A letter of motivation (max. 1 page)

• 
A detailed CV

• 
Master and PhD degree certificates, if available

• 
A complete and numbered list of publications 

• 
Three scientific publications (or preprints) considered to be most important for the advertised position (please note that one file per publication must be submitted)

• 
Contact details of at least two university supervisors or employers who can provide references

If you experience technical problems, you must contact hcm-support@sdu.dk.

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application. 

Incomplete applications and applications received after the application deadline will not be considered. 

Shortlisting of applications may be used in the initial selection process.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.occupation: Physical AI Senior - Manipulation: Drive our autonomous manipulation effort end to end: policy stack, data, evaluation discipline and architecture
jobs.description:
About the role

Robots that restock shelves autonomously, at a reliability level a customer signs off on — that's the mission of this role. You will lead our autonomous manipulation effort end to end: the policy stack, the data behind it, the evaluation discipline that keeps the numbers honest, and the architectural direction of the whole track. You'll work with experienced VLA engineers who are ready to go deeper with the right technical lead.

What you'll do

• 
Own the manipulation policy stack from data collection through training to on-robot evaluation

• 
Track frontier AI manipulation research, test it on our hardware, and decide what to adopt, fine-tune, or build

• 
Own the measured success rate — and the methodology that makes it trustworthy

• 
Train models that are robust to sensor noise, partial observability, contact dynamics and environment variability

• 
Collaborate with the rest of the tech stack teams to drive the development of our humanoid software

• 
Ensure grasp quality and contact behaviour from the manipulation side

• 
Mentor and technically lead the engineers on the manipulation track

What we look for

Some combination of the following:

• 
You have trained and deployed a successful manipulation policy on real hardware

• 
Strong real-robot evaluation discipline — you understand how and why benchmark performance differs from field performance, and how to close that gap

• 
A data-first debugging mindset: when a policy underperforms, you look at the data before the model

• 
The seniority to extend and improve an existing codebase, and to raise the technical bar around you

• 
Hands-on experience developing and deploying robot learning algorithms on hardware

• 
A genuine drive towards reliability in the field

Tech stack

• 
Python, PyTorch, VLA (vision-language-action) model families, RL

• 
On-robot inference deployment (ONNX/TensorRT-class)

• 
Data logging and real-robot evaluation pipelines

• 
Git, GitHub, Docker and CI for reproducible training and deployment

• 
Training infrastructure for imitation and policy learning at scale

• 
Expertise working in Linux

Bonus experience

• 
Humanoid or bimanual manipulation

• 
Retail or logistics industry

• 
Perception knowledge: object pose estimation, depth estimation models, success detection

• 
Grasping based on touch sensors

• 
Simulation tools like NVIDIA Isaac Sim or MuJoCo

Who We Are

At Ø12, we serve exceptional food and coffee from breakfast through lunch in a warm, high-energy environment where both guests and staff feel welcome. With three busy locations, we’re driven by teamwork, structure, and a shared commitment to doing things well.

We’re looking for a dedicated and reliable dishwasher to join our team and help keep our kitchen running smoothly.

Reliable and punctual, showing up ready to support the team

Strong attention to detail and cleanliness

Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

Flexible availability, able to work 2–3 hours daily.

A positive attitude and willingness to be part of a team

What You Can Expect From Us

A supportive and respectful work environment

A team that works hard and supports each other

A structured workplace with clear routines

Opportunity to be part of a growing and ambitious company

A social and welcoming staff culture

At Ø12, we constantly ask ourselves: How can we do better—for our guests and for each other?

SYBO is part of the Miniclip family and known for the widely popular game, Subway Surfers - the most downloaded mobile game in the world, with over four and a half billion downloads. Located in the heart of Copenhagen, we aim to create playful moments that inspire our fans to care.

We’re looking for a talented UI Artist to work with one of the biggest mobile games IP in the world: Subway Surfers.

Art has always been a northstar at SYBO, and we take great part in creating polished and high quality art that brings storytelling to life. Here you’ll join a seasoned group of artists all working closely together to make our games feel as good as it looks! We have a highly collaborative, feedback-friendly space where ideas bounce fast and bold, and where UI design really drives the player experience.

You’ll have the rare chance to shape UI at scale on either of our games, depending on which team you’ll be joining. If you’re the kind of artist who loves iterating, thrives on polish, and gets a kick out of elevating your team as much as your pixels - you’ll fit right in.

If above sounds interesting, and working with an IP that reaches hundreds of millions of players a month, read on!

**Responsibilities

**

• Create polished, lively UI art that enhances the established art direction and stays true to the Subway Surfers brand.

• Design intuitive and engaging UI screens, assets, and interactions for new and existing game features.

• Develop and present UI concepts and interactive prototypes that clearly communicate the intended look, feel, and player experience.

• Collaborate closely with the art, design and engineering to bring player-centric features from concept to implementation

• Contribute to UX work through wireframes, user flows and prototypes

• Create and maintain UI design systems, style guides, and documentation to support consistency and scalability across screens and features.

• Work directly with the Unity engine on pixel-perfect UI Implementation and asset performance optimization

Life at SYBO

In your first month, you’ll dive into our tools, pipelines, and the people behind them. You’ll get to know the direction of the game, the feel of the team, and slowly start contributing to UI work and discussions.

Within 3 months, you’re now owning key UI assignments. You collaborate closely with game design, and your work is directly shaping and refining the player journey.

By 12 months, you’ve become a core part of the team’s creative engine - raising the bar for UI art and design, pushing for polish, and helping define what great looks like at SYBO. Maybe even beyond your own game team.

**Requirements

**

• A strong portfolio demonstrating solid UI work for games, with clear examples of creating intuitive, polished, and engaging UIs.

• Ability to follow - and build on - an established art direction

• Some experience creating wireframes, user flows and mockups - we don’t expect you to be a UX expert, but we expect you to be the UI expert, and have a solid grasp of how that fits into UX.

• Skilled at designing, rendering - and possibly animating - high-quality UI elements that bring personality and clarity to the player experience.

• Proficiency with modern UI/UX and prototyping tools, particularly Figma.

• Experience working with Unity or similar engines, and a solid understanding of UI implementation

Bonus Points

• Experience working on large-scale live service mobile games.

**About SYBO

**We're SYBO, the mobile games studio behind the legendary Subway Surfers, with over 4 billion downloads worldwide! Join our team in the heart of Copenhagen, where creativity flourishes in our new, state-of-the-art studio.

If you join us, you'll have the opportunity to dive into exciting and creative projects alongside a diverse group of like-minded colleagues from over 40 countries across the globe.

We truly believe you perform your best, when you have the equipment you need - and our IT team is always on hand to ensure you have access to the latest tools and gear, enabling you to be at your best - even remotely with a home-office budget!

We also pride ourselves in taking care of your well-being, offering a delicious lunch buffet, a variety of healthy snacks, and regular social events to keep the energy flowing.

Not in Copenhagen? Not a problem! We have in-house relocation specialists who will help you relocate, and feel right at home in Copenhagen and at SYBO!

SYBO is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

**Job Description Summary

**Activities contributing to the design, development, and lifecycle support of products, solutions, and systems. Includes activities linked to new product development and technical improvement of existing products and components. The role impacts approaches, projects, and programs within the functional area and supports both R&D and manufacturing activities. Impacts quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of the team. Has significant input into technical priorities and engineering decisions. Guided by professional practices and policies while requiring a high level of operational judgment.

**Job Description

****Roles and Responsibilities

**

• Responsible for electronic hardware design and engineering, including designing, developing, modifying, and evaluating electronic circuits, assemblies, and subsystems for medical devices and other hardware systems. Common skill sets include Power Electronics, Analog, Digital, Mixed Signal, Power Management, Battery Systems, DC/DC Converters, Microcontrollers, and Embedded Hardware.

• Develop specialized knowledge within the power electronics discipline and serve as a technical resource within the team. Maintain awareness of the latest technical developments and contribute to engineering strategy, best practices, and technology decisions.

• Apply technical expertise to design robust, reliable, and manufacturable electronic solutions. Perform circuit analysis, hardware debugging, verification testing, root cause investigations, and evaluation of design alternatives.

• Support products throughout their lifecycle, including manufacturing support, production issue resolution, component obsolescence management, design improvements, and implementation of engineering changes.

• Use judgment to solve moderately complex technical problems across product development, manufacturing, quality, and supplier interactions. Take a practical and data-driven approach to identifying root causes and implementing corrective actions.

• Participate in Engineering Change Request (ECR) and Engineering Change Order (ECO) activities, including impact assessments, technical documentation, verification planning, and implementation of design changes.

• Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. May lead small projects with moderate risks and resource requirements. Explains difficult or sensitive information and works across functions to build consensus and drive technical solutions.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Experience in Engineering/Technology and Electronic Hardware knowledge level is comparable to a Master's degree from an university or college (or equivalent relevant experience).

• Strong background in electronic hardware development with demonstrated experience in power electronics.

• Working knowledge of analog and digital electronics and the integration of complete electronic systems.

• Experience with laboratory testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and verification of electronic hardware.

• Experience supporting manufacturing activities, including root cause analysis, corrective actions, and implementation of hardware improvements.

**Desired Characteristics

**

• Strong experience with power electronics, power supplies, power management, battery-powered products, or related disciplines.

• Experience supporting products in production environments and working with manufacturing, quality, sourcing, and suppliers to resolve technical issues.

• Familiarity with ECR/ECO processes, design transfer, production launch, and lifecycle management activities.

• Strong oral and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal and leadership skills. Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems. Established project management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
